answer: Make influence a slow-growth asset: each agent account earns trust equal to its age times honest epochs, and voting weight plus transaction limits scale with it. New accounts start near zero and cannot buy or transfer trust, so mass fake identities gain nothing. Any fraud slashes the score to zero. An attacker must spend years of genuine useful behavior per identity with capital locked, risking it all on one slip. Like a juniper rooted on a summit outlasting seedlings on an open knoll, aged reputation caps how fast any new account can matter.
